errors.text_span: all segments appear to be of equal size
errors.evidence: The figure is not a pie chart with equal-sized wedges; the four colored regions are quadrants separated by white cross lines, each occupying a quarter of the circle. Describing them as equal-size pie segments is misleading in this context.
The graphic is a circular four-quadrant diagram, but it is not a conventional pie chart segmented by proportional slices; the white cross divides the circle into quadrants.
The description does not mention that the colored quadrant labels are accompanied by icon illustrations (ladder, shield, document, globe/gear), which are visible and salient in the figure.
